}}'''Willim Avarhin''' was an impoverished [[Nobility|nobleman]] from [[Andor]].{{ref/book|c|Willim Avarhin}}

==History==
He lived in a small manor house in [[Caemlyn]] with his daughter, [[Shiaine Avarhin]]. The [[Darkfriend]] [[Mili Skane]] murdered them both and assumed Shiaine's identity.{{ref/book|9|10}}
